description: The ACME settings: the instance CA, its account and every stored account

server.description: The instance CA's ACME directory URL

server_source.description: Where the CA comes from: ACME_SERVER, the saved setting or the Let's Encrypt default

email.description: The contact email of the instance CA's account (ACME_EMAIL when set), empty when none

eab_kid_set.description: Whether an EAB key ID is set (by the environment or stored); the value is never returned

eab_hmac_key_set.description: Whether an EAB HMAC key is set (by the environment or stored); the value is never returned

account.description: The instance CA's account, null when it has none yet

locked.description: The fields an environment variable sets; a PUT ignores them

locked_by.description: For each locked field, the environment variable that sets it

eab.description: Whether the CA needs an External Account Binding

accounts.description: Every stored account, one per CA

warning.description: unreachable: the CA could not be reached, the account is stored as pending
